configuration.policy: 仅从环境变量读取；不加载旧生产config.yaml；示例没有真实密钥
configuration.reverse_proxy: ROUTE_TRUSTED_PROXIES必须只配置真实反向代理CIDR；空值不信任任何XFF/X-Real-IP
configuration.cors: ROUTE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS只能配置精确HTTPS origin；浏览器同源与native请求不依赖CORS
configuration.otp_authority: 租户chart负责发码、校验、用途/账号/区号绑定、限频、失败冷却、最终原子核销；route不再生成/存储公开OTP或替换forwardCode
configuration.registration_auth: Per-tenant ROUTE_UPSTREAM_SECRETS JSON map (serverID -> >=32-character secret). Chart matching LUOBO_ROUTE_SHARED_SECRET. Missing tenant secret disables registration and never falls back to unsigned writes.

build.container: Dockerfile exists; container image build/runtime not yet verified

migration.schema: sql/init.sql has original schema DDL only, no production data or seeds
migration.initialization: Back up DB first; ./route-service -migrate creates missing tables via GORM and exits. Existing model schema retained. Do not run against production without backup and reviewed diff.
migration.existing_binding_keys: Old user_id stores phone only without country; preserve unchanged as read-only routing fallback. Tenant chart still authenticates exact areaCode+phone, so a fallback does not assign ownership.
migration.new_binding_keys: phone:{normalized +area}:{phone}; email:{base64url SHA256(lowercase email)}; all fit old VARCHAR(50). No automatic reassignment/mass rewrite.
migration.rollback: Before initial rollout preserve existing DB dump and old binary/config privately. New country/email keys are additive records; do not erase them or restore old snapshot over new writes without a reconciliation window.
migration.repair: Unknown network outcome preserves reservation and original tenant. Retry same registration identity/invitation queries an HMAC-signed receipt; registered+IM provisioned+same ID/identity enables idempotent binding and instructs fresh login. Manual /route/bind rejects pending intent instead of double-counting. Never release an uncertain reservation only because it is old.
migration.registration_intent: Additive registration_intent table: UUIDv4, canonical account key, tenant, invite, state, upstream user ID and 60-second processing lease only. No credential, OTP or request payload. Pending reservations are included in existing capacity/usage counters.

management.authentication: X-Route-Admin-Token or Authorization: Bearer; fail closed when configured secret is shorter than 32 characters
management.binding: Server row lock + invite row lock + binding insertion + usage counters in one transaction; repeated identical binding does not increment counters

runbook: Provision MySQL database and least-privilege account; supply secrets using deployment secret manager
Initialize/review schema on a copied DB; configure servers/default tenant/invitation rows through existing administration workflow
Configure route ingress TLS and actual proxy CIDRs, configure chart trusted route egress addresses for reported client IP
Configure tenant chart real email/SMS provider and verification-purpose migration; disabled-provider fake success is not acceptable
Configure per-tenant HMAC registration secrets in route and chart, migrate additive intent/receipt schemas; validate lost-response and restart recovery with synthetic accounts.
Probe GET /api/health and execute phone/email register→login→reset→old-session rejection in isolated staging
Use route management credential only from trusted administrator backend; never ship it to end-user Web or App bundles

SMS adapters are preserved and tested with fake transports; public OTP is chart-owned; real SMS/email delivery not yet verified
In-memory route IP limiter is process-local; tenant chart authoritative account/purpose/IP throttles must be configured across replicas
No live device/Web end-to-end or production rollout is claimed
